lines.text: Oi! Is that a walk, or are you being dragged?
Nice hat. Did a scarecrow lose a bet?
I've met turnips with better posture!
Go on, run along! Don't trip over your own opinion!
My potions smell better than you, and one of them is made of cabbage and regret!
Is that your face, or is it still a rough draft?
You walk like a goat on a skateboard!
I'd insult your boots, but they've already given up.
Hey, beanpole! How's the weather up there?
That Jeep is louder than your personality, and that's saying something!
Stand there much longer and the pigeons will mistake you for a statue!
I once brewed a potion to cure boredom. Turns out it was you.
Big rifle, tiny courage!
Come closer! I won't bite. Much.
You punch like a sleepy butterfly!
Lost your map, or just your dignity?
Don't mind me, I'm just admiring how slowly you can do absolutely nothing.
Your shadow called. It wants a better owner.
Ow! My beard!
Hey! Those are my good ribs!
Oof! Rude!
Ow! Mind the potions!
You hit like a mule with a grudge!
Oi! I bruise like a peach!
Aaah! Big stick, big bang!
Ow! Is that even legal?!
Argh! Watch where you point that thing!
Ha! Missed me! Learn to aim!
Is that all? Even the trees are laughing!
Whoops, wrong dwarf!
Hey! I'm walking here!
Slow down, you maniac!
Tell my potions... I loved them...
I regret... absolutely nothing... ugh.
Miss me?
Ha! Did you really think that would work?
I'm back, and twice as annoying!

effects.prompt: comedic cartoon scream of a short grumpy man being launched high into the air, fading into the distance
